Sub:- Exemption us/ 17(1)(a) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952 and u/p 27A of the 
EPF Scheme, 1952 forwarding of proposals - reg. 
Sir, 
Please refer to Head Office letter of even number dated 27/04/09. 
2)
In this context, it is informed that as per the Finance Bill 2009, the last 
date for obtaining exemption u/s 17 of the EPF & MP Act has been extended till 
31/12/2010, failing which the income tax benefits available to a P.F Trust shall be 
withdrawn. 
3)
From time to time, it has been brought to the notice of all RPFCs that 
exemption proposals/clarifications pending in their offices should be forwarded to 
Head Office immediately for further necessary action, however it has been 
observed that still a number of proposals/clarifications are pending with the 
respective field offices. 
4)
You are therefore directed to ensure that all pending proposals for grant of 
exemption as well as the required clarifications are submitted to Head Office 
latest by 15/04/2010 positively. You are also directed to initiate necessary action 
for withdrawal of relaxation in cases where the concerned establishment does 
not submit the requisite documents/clarifications for grant of exemption. 
It is reiterated that if any proposal/clarification is submitted after 
15/04/2010 the concerned RPFC shall be personally responsible for any 
subsequent delay in the processing of the case and other consequences arising 
thereafter. 
Yours faithfully, 
(P. Sudhaka 
Additional Central P.F. Commissioner(mption)
